articles.summary: First United Bank & Trust welcomed golfers, sponsors, and community supporters to the Oakland Golf Club on Friday, July 10, 2026, for its 38th Annual Charity Golf Tournament, continuing a longstanding tradition of community giving through friendly competition.
articles.title: First United Hosts 38th Annual Charity Golf Tournament

articles.summary: First United Bank & Trust is proud to announce that eight associates have been promoted to Vice President, recognizing their exceptional leadership, dedication, and contributions to the organization’s continued growth.
articles.title: Eight Associates Promoted to Vice President at First United Bank & Trust

articles.summary: First United Bank & Trust is proud to announce its participation in Frederick County Transit's Adopt-a-Stop Program through the adoption of the bus stop located on Riverbend Way in Frederick.
articles.title: First United Bank & Trust Adopts Frederick Transit Stop Through Community Partnership Program
